DECIDED 2026-06-09: MCP stays as a product surface. Don't re-litigate from token economics — after the #124-#127 diet the surface delta is noise; the token lever is store discipline, not transport.

FLEET POLICY (2026-07-22, supersedes 'prefer MCP' for local agents): transport follows capability. Shell-capable agents (Claude Code = 'fable', Codex = 'sol') use the rvr CLI uniformly — one AGENTS.md contract (CLAUDE.md is now just an AGENTS.md import), RVR_AGENT_NAME attribution set in each harness's env config (~/.claude/settings.json env block, ~/.codex/config.toml shell_environment_policy). MCP is for shell-less surfaces only (Claude Cowork/Desktop), registered app-level; repo .mcp.json REMOVED — never re-add project-level MCP config. Rationale: MCP registration is inherently per-client (every client invents its own config format), so the CLI is the only uniform surface; MCP's remaining advantages are guardrail ergonomics and reach (schema-validated params, confirm tokens, default session identity, no-shell clients), not functionality — rvr manifest confirms the 1:1 tool map.

CONSEQUENCES: (a) MCP demoted from ambient daily surface to deliberately-tested product surface — must be exercised explicitly before releases, it no longer gets ambient dogfooding coverage; (b) project.soakPolicy EXIT GATE requires >=10 distinct MCP sessions — unsatisfiable under this policy, rewrite the gate before the next soak eval; (c) fleet CLI sessions are un-bridged (no RVR_SESSION — static harness env can't express per-session ids, and merging all sessions into one static id would be worse) so write-amp guard is inert and session stats fragment; the product gaps this exposes: ambient agent detection from harness env fingerprints (feeds #45) and harness-free session derivation (the #119 leftover).

THE REAL LEDGER (unchanged for Reverie USERS): MCP is push (.mcp.json auto-inject = the adoption channel), serves no-shell surfaces, is safer for writes (JSON params vs shell-quoting KB seeds), and is a commercial checkbox; CLI serves the MCP-banned cohort and wins filterable reads via pipes. Neither is redundant — the dual-surface design stays. KILL CRITERIA unchanged. See [[context.surfaceTokenEconomics]], [[project.cliAgentParity]].
